Piece.m_targetNonPlayerBuilt: Allows enemies to target this piece even if not player-built. (?)
Piece.m_icon: The icon displayed for this piece in the build menu.
Piece.m_name: The display name of the piece.
Piece.m_description: The description text shown in the build menu.
Piece.m_enabled: Determines if this piece is available to be built.
Piece.m_category: The build menu tab category this piece belongs to.
Piece.m_isUpgrade: If true, this piece acts as a crafting station upgrade.
Piece.m_comfort: The amount of comfort value this piece provides to players.
Piece.m_comfortGroup: Prevents comfort stacking with other items in the same group.
Piece.m_comfortObject: The specific child object that defines the source of comfort. (?)
Piece.m_groundPiece: Forces the piece to require solid ground contact to exist.
Piece.m_allowAltGroundPlacement: Allows placing the piece on imperfect or uneven ground. (?)
Piece.m_groundOnly: Restricts placement so the piece must sit directly on ground.
Piece.m_cultivatedGroundOnly: Restricts placement so the piece must sit on cultivated soil.
Piece.m_waterPiece: Allows the piece to be built in or on water.
Piece.m_clipGround: Allows the piece to partially clip into the ground.
Piece.m_clipEverything: Allows the piece to clip through any other objects.
Piece.m_noInWater: Prevents the piece from being built in water.
Piece.m_notOnWood: Prevents the piece from being placed on wood structures.
Piece.m_notOnTiltingSurface: Prevents the piece from being placed on sloped surfaces.
Piece.m_inCeilingOnly: Restricts placement so the piece must hang from ceilings.
Piece.m_notOnFloor: Prevents the piece from being placed on flat floors.
Piece.m_noClipping: Prevents this piece from clipping into other structures.
Piece.m_onlyInTeleportArea: Allows placing this piece only inside active teleport areas. (?)
Piece.m_allowedInDungeons: Allows players to build this piece inside dungeons.
Piece.m_spaceRequirement: The clear clearance radius required around the piece to build.
Piece.m_repairPiece: If true, this piece represents the hammer's repair action. (?)
Piece.m_removePiece: If true, this piece represents the hammer's deconstruct action. (?)
Piece.m_canRotate: Allows players to rotate the piece before building it.
Piece.m_randomInitBuildRotation: Randomizes the rotation of the piece when it is built.
Piece.m_canBeRemoved: Allows players to dismantle and remove the placed piece.
Piece.m_canRockJade: Enables rocking or swaying physics behavior for the piece. (?)
Piece.m_allowRotatedOverlap: Allows the piece to overlap others when rotated. (?)
Piece.m_vegetationGroundOnly: Restricts placement to ground covered by vegetation. (?)
Piece.m_blockingPieces: List of other pieces that cannot be built near this.
Piece.m_blockRadius: The exclusion radius where blocking pieces cannot be built.
Piece.m_mustConnectTo: The target network object this piece must connect to. (?)
Piece.m_connectRadius: The search radius used to find the required connection object.
Piece.m_mustBeAboveConnected: Forces this piece to be built above its connected object.
Piece.m_noVines: Prevents decorative vines from growing on this piece. (?)
Piece.m_extraPlacementDistance: Extends the player's build reach distance for this piece.
Piece.m_onlyInBiome: Restricts building this piece to specific game biomes.
Piece.m_harvest: Enables harvesting interactions on this piece. (?)
Piece.m_harvestRadius: The interaction radius for harvesting this piece. (?)
Piece.m_harvestRadiusMaxLevel: The maximum harvest radius at highest upgrade level. (?)
Piece.m_placeEffect: Visual and audio effects triggered upon placing this piece.
Piece.m_dlc: Restricts construction to players owning the specified DLC.
Piece.m_craftingStation: The nearby crafting station required to build this piece.
Piece.m_returnResourceHeightOffset: Height offset where refunded building materials are spawned.
Piece.m_resources: The list of item materials required to craft this.
Piece.m_destroyedLootPrefab: Prefab containing items dropped when this piece is destroyed.
StaticTarget.m_primaryTarget: Marks this piece as a high-priority target for enemies.
StaticTarget.m_randomTarget: Marks this piece as a random target for enemy attacks.
WearNTear.m_onDestroyed: Event action triggered when this piece is destroyed.
WearNTear.m_onDamaged: Event action triggered when this piece takes damage.
WearNTear.m_new: The visual model representing the undamaged state.
WearNTear.m_worn: The visual model representing the damaged state.
WearNTear.m_broken: The visual model representing the nearly broken state.
WearNTear.m_wet: Visual model overlay applied when the piece is wet.
WearNTear.m_noRoofWear: Disables deterioration when exposed to rain without roof cover.
WearNTear.m_noSupportWear: Disables damage and collapse caused by lack of structural support.
WearNTear.m_ashDamageImmune: Makes this piece immune to Ashlands environmental fire damage. (?)
WearNTear.m_ashDamageResist: Gives this piece resistance to Ashlands environmental damage. (?)
WearNTear.m_burnable: Enables this piece to catch fire and take burn damage.
WearNTear.m_materialType: The material category, determining structural support values.
WearNTear.m_supports: Allows this piece to support other structural pieces.
WearNTear.m_comOffset: Offset for the center of mass calculation. (?)
WearNTear.m_forceCorrectCOMCalculation: Forces high-precision center of mass calculations. (?)
WearNTear.m_staticPosition: Prevents physics forces from moving this object. (?)
WearNTear.m_nonSolidRenderers: Renderers that do not affect physical collisions. (?)
WearNTear.m_health: The maximum durability or health of the structure.
WearNTear.m_damages: Custom damage resistances and weaknesses for this piece.
WearNTear.m_minToolTier: Minimum tool tier required to damage or dismantle this.
WearNTear.m_hitNoise: The noise level generated when this piece is struck.
WearNTear.m_destroyNoise: The noise level generated when this piece is destroyed.
WearNTear.m_triggerPrivateArea: Triggers ward alerts if this piece is damaged inside one. (?)
WearNTear.m_destroyedEffect: Visual and audio effects triggered upon destruction.
WearNTear.m_hitEffect: Visual and audio effects triggered when struck.
WearNTear.m_switchEffect: Effects played when switching between wear states. (?)
WearNTear.m_autoCreateFragments: Automatically spawns broken fragments when destroyed.
WearNTear.m_fragmentRoots: Object roots used to generate physics debris fragments.
